name: Awkwaddle
ability: Swift Swim / Slush Rush / Water Veil (hidden)
look: a chubby navy penguin chick with a white belly, oversized swim goggles, a blue swim ring round its middle, little flippers, yellow feet and nervous sweat drops
entry: It can't swim yet, so it never takes off its swim ring and goggles. It slips over on the ice all the time, and sweats with nerves even in a blizzard.
how: Wild: common on snowy beaches, frozen rivers and oceans, and in snowy biomes.
Evolves into Waddical at level 33, learning Wave Crash.
